request: Automatically choose a platform-specific library path

candidates.prompt: One simple square software icon on pure white: bold dark-blue computer monitor on left, a thick black branching path on right with one branch highlighted green. Represents automatically choosing a platform-specific library path. Flat simple geometry, generous margin, no text, no border, no shadow.

source.evidence: The blue computer connects to three branches; only green identifies the chosen branch.

30x18.cause: The highlighted branch is encoded only by color.

16x16.evidence: Monitor and branching silhouette remain visible.

candidates.concept_summary: Cursor selects a library from two choices
candidates.prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on white for choosing a library. Draw TWO LARGE distinct rectangular LIBRARY MODULE BLOCKS side by side, one blue on left and one orange on right, each with one prominent puzzle-tab silhouette. Place a LARGE BLACK MOUSE CURSOR POINTER from lower left aimed at and touching ONLY the orange module. The cursor and two blocks must be widely separated and bold, with clear point of contact. No book, file drawer, monitor, check mark, letters, numbers, gears, shadows or tags. Simple shapes readable at 30x18. Center artwork in middle 70 percent of square.

signature.composition: two separate blue and orange library puzzle blocks with large cursor

29x29.evidence: Both modules and pointer are distinct.

source.evidence: A black cursor points at the orange of two puzzle-shaped module choices.

16x16.evidence: The two modules and pointer survive with softened edges.
